name: tooltip-aria
title: Tooltip (React Aria)
description: A short text hint for a control that opens on hover after a delay and on keyboard focus, and closes with Escape, on Radix, Base UI or React Aria.
author: Design From Labs <https://labs.designfrom.com>
docs:
Installed `Tooltip`. Import it from `@/components/ui/tooltip`.

Radix and Base UI: wrap your app once in `TooltipProvider`, then compose `Tooltip`, `TooltipTrigger` and `TooltipContent`. React Aria: put the trigger and `Tooltip` inside `TooltipTrigger`.
